voice.name: Test Voice
voice.basis: the channel's established narrator (same id as Zombie Ant, Zombie Snail and Myostatin); confirmed with creative_list_voices on 2026-11-01

prompt: [eerie, intense, urgent] If you freeze this frog, its HEART completely STOPS! [low, eerie, deliberate] Ice spreads through its body, it stops breathing, and it looks completely dead. [brisk, intrigued, building] But its liver releases massive amounts of sugar, protecting its cells while the rest of its body freezes! [amazed] It can survive like this for weeks! [hushed wonder, building] And when spring arrives, the ice melts, its heart starts beating again… [astonished, delighted] And it just HOPS AWAY like nothing happened!
prompt_note: The approved words, verbatim (production/NARRATION_LOCKED.txt), with the brief's capitals. The bracket tags direct delivery (eerie and intense at first, increasingly astonished through the revival) and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 528.9 credits. No regeneration.

takes.why_not: weaker emphasis on 'freeze' (+1.3 dB) and 'STOPS' (+1.6 dB) over the median word, and 'again…' trails off to -14.5 dB; whisper hears "It's heart"

takes.asr: whisper base.en: word-perfect; zipformer: only 'its cells' heard as 'itselves'

edits: None. The take's sentence gaps are already 0.21-0.51 s, so it is used sample for sample: no gap edits, no time-stretch, no pitch or gain change. A 1.62 s tail after the last word carries the hop, the landing and the cold returning into the loop.
word_timing: local sherpa-onnx Zipformer token timestamps snapped to measured pause onsets (tools/align_zipformer.py -> audio/narration/master_zipformer.json)
listening: Not listened to in real time: this environment has no audio playback. Selection by two ASR models, pause and level measurement.

v4.why: The V4 brief asks for a calmer read with the same voice identity: controlled amazement, slight eeriness, natural pacing, selective emphasis, no shouting of STOPS, DEAD, WEEKS or FREEZES.
v4.prompt: [controlled amazement, slightly eerie, natural conversational pace] If you freeze this frog, its heart completely stops. [low, steady, a little eerie] Ice spreads through its body, it stops breathing, and it looks completely dead. [curious, quietly building] But its liver releases massive amounts of sugar, protecting its cells while the rest of its body freezes. [calm wonder] It can survive like this for weeks. [warmer, gently rising] And when spring arrives, the ice melts, its heart starts beating again… [light, amused, natural] And it just hops away like nothing happened.
v4.prompt_note: The same 67 approved words in the same order. To avoid a shouted delivery, the emphasis words are written in normal case and the exclamation marks as full stops in the TTS prompt only; the subtitles keep the approved text, capitals and punctuation. The bracket tags direct delivery and are not spoken.
v4.generated_once: One run of two variations, 2 x 579.9 credits. No regeneration.

takes.why_not: whisper hears an inserted 'buzzer buzzes' (an artefact) and 'it's'; 'HOPS AWAY' at +6.3/+8.7 dB is the most pushed word of all

takes.asr: whisper base.en: word-perfect; zipformer: 'its cells' heard as 'itselves'
takes.emphasis_note: measured over the median word: 'STOPS' +2.7 dB, 'dead' -5.6, 'freezes' -4.0, 'weeks' -3.2 (none shouted); the strongest emphasis is on the payoff, 'hops away' (+6 dB)

v4.edits: The four longest silent gaps (0.43-0.64 s, before 'Ice', 'But', 'It' and 'And') were shortened to 0.34 s, 0.77 s in all, each cut in the middle of the silence with a 12 ms crossfade. Every word is used sample for sample. tools/make_narration_v4.py
v4.picture_timing: The V3 picture is keyed to the V1 word times; source/src/warp.ts maps V4 time onto that clock through 25 word anchors with a smooth monotone curve, so every event lands on the new voice.
v4.listening: Not listened to in real time (no audio playback in this environment). Selection by two ASR models and level measurement.
